title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_ecchi_gallery_by_takumi_kobayashi_c8fuf (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_ecchi_gallery_by_takumi_kobayashi_c8fuf' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee full remediation due to potential persistence of malicious software.
